tail:
Completed the 55-page review in the [drift report](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-alpha-step1-drift.md). It records 49 `no-drift`, 2 `drift-applied`, and 4 `drift-blocked` verdicts.

Added the finite-dimensional change-of-variables and inverse-function prerequisites for the gauge-slice page, and the differentiation-under-the-integral prerequisite for finite-dimensional Q-exact localization. The reviewed arguments are in [Lebl’s *Basic Analysis II*](https://www.jirka.org/ra/realanal2.pdf).

The plan validator exited successfully with 27 redundant-prerequisite warnings. The drift checker reported the four owner holds: unpinned Lie-superalgebra suppliers, unresolved proof acceptance for reductive invariant theory, Hall-chain proof-status reconciliation, and a Wilsonian theorem that depends on a later definition and would create a cycle. The run remains held pending owner resolution; the checker reports no automatic re-review. I also checked the invariant-theory arguments in [Milne](https://www.jmilne.org/math/Books/iAG2022.pdf) and [Brion](https://www.numdam.org/item/CCIRM_2010__1_1_1_0/); the hold is their recorded proof status, not a defect found in those arguments.
